components.name: dry_node
components.evaluation: Broad cream/ochre banks and lavender shade match the existing painted family. Calm circular dry earth or aqua water is a readable excavation node; its physical network mounting remains pending.
components.qualification: Direct native sheet and each of four visible complete components inspected. Source-only; no native in-game mounting, continuous network, task/contact/timing or owner acceptance.
components.region_annotation_correction: Initial half-height quadrant at627 cut the nodes and included their tails in channel windows. Corrected from complete native directly inspected after browser card review; top/bottom separation uses790 in the transparent gap. No image pixel edited.
